facts.fact: Eleven Zambian civil society organisations, including Transparency International Zambia and MISA, said in a joint statement that the Cyber Security and Cyber Crimes Bills still need substantial safeguards against abuse and overreach.
facts.system: Cyber Security Bill and Cyber Crimes Bill

facts.fact: The civil society signatories say the government deferred the Cyber Bills and created a platform for dialogue with civil society groups, at which they made submissions, though many recommendations were rejected.
facts.system: Cyber Security Bill and Cyber Crimes Bill
